# authwise_install_status (Data Source)

The install's license state and its registration with the portal that issued the license, as of kit's last check (at boot and daily). Only the install's operators may read it: any other credential is refused. The license itself is kit configuration (`license.token`, `license.keys`), set by the operator, not a resource. No state changes what the install does: it is recorded and reported only. Needs kit 1.94.0 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The install's license and registration, read with an operator's
# credential.
data "authwise_install_status" "this" {}

# Fail the plan when the license is not valid.
check "license" {
  assert {
    condition     = data.authwise_install_status.this.license.state == "valid"
    error_message = "The install's license is ${data.authwise_install_status.this.license.state}."
  }
}

# An install that cannot reach the portal uploads this to register.
output "registration_payload" {
  value = data.authwise_install_status.this.registration.payload
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The install's id (`install.id`), set by the operator; empty when unset.
- `kit_version` (String) The running kit build's version.
- `license` (Attributes) The license as of the last check. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--license))
- `name` (String) The install's name (`install.name`).
- `registration` (Attributes) Registration with the portal that issued the license. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--registration))
- `url` (String) The install's URL (`install.url`); empty when unset.

<a id="nestedatt--license"></a>
### Nested Schema for `license`

Read-Only:

- `checked_at` (String) When the license was last checked, RFC 3339.
- `exp` (String) When the license expires, RFC 3339; null unless it verified.
- `grace_until` (String) The expiry plus the license's grace days, RFC 3339; null unless it verified.
- `keys` (Attributes) The key set the state was decided against; null when none was available. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--license--keys))
- `license_id` (String) The license's id (`lic-…`); empty unless the license verified.
- `org` (String) The licensed organization's id (`org-…`); empty unless the license verified.
- `plan` (String) The license's plan, e.g. `FREE`; empty unless the license verified.
- `state` (String) `absent`, `valid`, `grace`, `expired`, `revoked` or `invalid`.

<a id="nestedatt--license--keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `license.keys`

Read-Only:

- `source` (String) `embedded` (built into this release), `file` (`license.keys`) or `fetched` (from the portal).
- `updated_at` (String) The set's own update time, RFC 3339; the newest set is used.



<a id="nestedatt--registration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `registration`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the install registers: on when a license is set, unless `install.register` is false.
- `last_attempt_at` (String) When registration was last attempted, RFC 3339; null if never.
- `last_result` (String) `ok`, or why the last attempt failed or was not sent; empty if never attempted.
- `payload` (String) Exactly the JSON the install sends, or would send, to the portal. An install that cannot reach the portal uploads this verbatim, so an `output` of it is the offline registration.
